integrity: The proof is symbolic and applies to every integer n at least 2. Exhaustive enumeration through n=8 is used only as a finite consistency check, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers equal-order one-edge barbells only. The foundational chapter was verified bibliographically rather than through full text, and an unindexed earlier family-specific result remains a residual literature risk. The exact day-level date is the publication date recorded for the containing proceedings volume.
title: Signed-domination weight enumerator of barbell graphs
